credibility._note: Ryan, 2026-11-22: audits and overdue instruments feed credibility; the phone shows a named band with the next one hinted; the first contract offers a lower-uncertainty standard at a discount for a run of on-time calibrations. Every number and band name here is [PLACEHOLDER]. Points stay between 0 and max_points. The discount applies to credits, not ore.

crops._note: Income milestone (Ryan, 2026-11-22: crop sales to Lin). Seeds cost this percentage of a crop's base_sell_credits, rounded, bought when planted. An in-spec harvest sells for base_sell_credits; one whose soil left its tolerance band on any growing day sells for out_of_spec_penalty_pct less. [PLACEHOLDER].

jobs._note: Paid calibration jobs (Ryan, 2026-11-22): customers post jobs to the phone board each morning once the lab is Trusted; Accredited adds tighter-tolerance, better-paying jobs. A job needs an owned standard of its discipline at min_tier or better, not at OIRM and traceable (in date) when the job is accepted, and a lab area of its discipline with room (see lab). A job with "area" needs an area at least that size. Late (after due_day) or untraceable (standard overdue) work pays less and costs credibility; a clean, on-time job earns a small bonus. A job not done by due_day + late_grace_days is cancelled and costs abandoned_job_points. Every customer, number and discipline mapping here is [PLACEHOLDER].

lab._note: Upgradeable lab (Ryan, 2026-11-22). The lab has a number of spaces for its size; each space is given to a discipline at the dome plan board. A discipline's spaces are its area: it can have that many jobs in progress at once, and its size (area_sizes, by spaces) decides which jobs fit. Growing to the next size costs credits and crystal ore and finishes build_days later, in the morning; the new spaces are then fitted out for free. Clearing a space for another discipline costs refit_credits and refit_ore and the space is down for refit_days. The lab starts small with a space for each discipline the founding standards cover. Every number here is [PLACEHOLDER].

shuttle._note: Zones doc section 8.2, build step 16, the rules half (Ryan, 2026-11-26: a day trip is about 40 CR a person; the shuttle license is lab level 20). Launch windows are a pure function of the game clock, nothing stored or sent. Hours are game hours counted from 06:00 of day 1. Phobos: a window opens every period_hours (11, so about two a day and drifting through the day) and stays open open_hours; offset_hours is when the first one opens. Deimos: open open_hours (60 h, 2.5 days), then shut shut_hours (60 h), from offset_hours. trip_hours is how long a day trip takes, there and back; one that would end after recall_hour (the 02:00 tunnel recall) is refused. party_most is the most people on one booking. The pad and its terminal are the next PR (biomes step 12); Phobos has its hub now (zones step 17, first half): a booking leaves at once for six hours, a party of everyone at the pad's terminal (shuttle parties), home free from the hub's console or when the trip ends; Deimos is refused with no_hub_text until its hub. Every number and every word here is [PLACEHOLDER].
